auditGaps.finding: Declared app Firebase BOM 31.1.1 differs from firebase_core wrapper SDK default 33.1.0. Exact-coordinate POMs retained, but no release-variant graph resolves actual selected native versions.
auditGaps.requiredAction: Generate and review a release-variant dependency graph and licence report on the Android build host, then add the resolved components before shipping Android.

auditGaps.finding: 25 Pub wrapper mappings independently authenticated; CocoaPods podspec checksum replay and native SDK/transitive licences remain unverified.
auditGaps.requiredAction: Resolve pods on the iOS build host, retain podspec/licence evidence, review notices, and regenerate before shipping iOS.

auditGaps.finding: Exact SQL.js 1.6.2 published artifact matched (WASM byte-identical, JS CRLF only), with MIT text and source commit/build recipe retained. Complete Corresponding Source, notices delivery and from-source rebuild remain unverified.
auditGaps.requiredAction: Review retained exact-artifact provenance; verify complete source/build distribution and include notices in release output before shipping.

auditGaps.finding: Bundled font binaries have no repository-local acquisition and redistribution evidence; Avenir requires especially careful commercial review.
auditGaps.requiredAction: Obtain licence/provenance evidence or replace each font with an approved asset; counsel or a qualified rights reviewer must clear redistribution.

auditGaps.finding: Category/application/promotional image sets lack a complete author/source/licence manifest.
auditGaps.requiredAction: Create per-source asset provenance, preserve notices, and replace or remove assets that cannot be cleared.

auditGaps.finding: Source URLs exist but version, licence, transformation, and per-record provenance are not recorded.
auditGaps.requiredAction: Pin source revisions, confirm database/content rights, document transformations, and retain required attribution.

auditGaps.finding: Modified/fork status is known, but exact upstream-to-fork patches and modification notices are not centrally recorded.
auditGaps.requiredAction: Record upstream revision, fork revision, patch/diff provenance, and required modification notices for every local or Git fork.

auditGaps.finding: Package licence identifiers and evidence paths are inventoried, but a release-specific compilation of every required copyright, attribution, NOTICE, modification, and source notice has not yet been legally reviewed.
auditGaps.requiredAction: Review the exact release graph and source licence files, populate the final third-party notice bundle without guessing, and obtain qualified approval before distribution.

auditGaps.finding: Current canonical baseline still contains com.budget.tracker_app / com.budget.tracker-app in 10 files; surviving repository compliance audit rejects these.
auditGaps.requiredAction: Separately review and authorise the application identity migration and its platform validation; do not import unrelated historical application commits.
auditGaps.releaseGate: Repository audit and any public binary
